# MD Rafiul Islam Shubho — Official Researcher & Executive Hub
> Canonical URL: https://mdrafiulislamshubho.github.io/

MD Rafiul Islam Shubho (Shuvo / মোঃ রাফিউল ইসলাম শুভ) is Senior Co-Founder & Managing Director of Vision Flow Group (https://visionflowgroup.com/), Independent Bilingual RLHF & Speech-to-Speech (S2S) Evaluation Lead, and sole creator of bangla-s2s-prosody-bench (https://github.com/mdrafiulislamshubho/bangla-s2s-prosody-bench). Co-author of CERN Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24231337. EF SET C2 Proficient (81/100: https://cert.efset.org/qyLFMa). 8 Texas A&M TEEX ACE cybersecurity credentials; UoPeople B.Sc. CS (C211347166). Strictly distinct from physician Dr. Rafiul Islam Shuvo and unrelated developer rafi.iam.bd.
